dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: Well, judging cases is not under my purview, but having seen my fair share of trials, I can't help but think of how I should handle various dilemmas...

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: Between the process and the result, which is more important?

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: Is there a way to balance reason and jurisprudence?

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: Between infinite time and infinite Mora, which would I choose?

dialogues.speaker: Esteban
dialogues.text: ...Oh, sorry, I'm all over the place, aren't I? Heh, not that these issues have anything to do with me, either...
